items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Cupie Austin, in McKenney's Cotton Pickers

ctx.x: Who were some of the best tempo keepers to your mind? A lot of times, you listen to things and peices start in one temp and then --

Oh, that was so many, so many good tempo men. Cupie Austin, in McKenney's Cotton Pickers, Big Sid Catlett, Jo Jones. Fall in on some breaks, there, snare drum to a sock cymbal, tom-toms, they were good men. Kaiser Marshall was a good -- had to be good to play with Fletcher Henderson's band. Old timer, but he stuck to his style.
Do you -- did you think that Fletcher Henderson's use of a lot of different keys had an effect on what kind of writing Sy Oliver did for Fletcher's band?
